biggest_catch: The referred friend must stay on Champion service for 60 consecutive days and their $50 credit only posts after those 60 days; a referral who uses your code is ineligible for any other Champion promotion.
catches: Referred customer must be a new Champion customer and keep electric service with Champion for a minimum of 60 consecutive days.
Referral's $50 bill credit is typically applied only after 60 days of receiving service as a Champion customer; participant's credit typically posts within 30 days of the referral commencing service.
Participant must be an active Champion residential or commercial customer in good standing (current on all payments).
Bill credits are never redeemable for cash refunds; if service ends before 60 days Champion may recover the credit via a charge on a future bill.
Champion may terminate or change the program or credit amounts at any time; over $599 in referral credits per calendar year requires a W-9 for tax purposes.
Savings framing: this reduces a future Champion bill, not cash income; the friend must enroll with Champion using your Referral ID (referrals using your code cannot stack other promotions).

steps: Get your Connect-A-Friend Referral ID from your Champion account or referral tools.
Share your Referral ID with a friend.
Friend enrolls as a new Champion customer online at championenergyservices.com and enters your Referral ID.
Friend keeps electric service with Champion for at least 60 consecutive days.
You receive a $50 bill credit (typically within 30 days of their service starting); your friend receives a $50 bill credit (typically after 60 days of service).
timing: Program effective until terminated by Champion. Participant credit typically within 30 days of referral's service start; referral credit after 60 days of service.
